lines: You came. Good. Sit, do not sit, whichever gets you talking faster.
I study movement. Not battling, not breeding. Movement.
Where things go, and why they all go at once.
Every seventy years the Hollow Sea turns over and the whole region gets up and walks.
We call it the Turning. It is not due for eleven more years.
It started four months ago.
I cannot walk the region any more. My knees have opinions.
So I am asking you to walk it for me, and write down what you see.
You will want company.
Good. Look after each other, and I mean that in both directions.
Here. This is the Vellum. It fills itself in as you go, more or less.
You received the Vellum, 5 Field Vessels and 3 Potions.
Ashgate is north up Route 1. Ask for Tirren's sister at the Waystation, she owes me a favour.
And if anything out there is somewhere it should not be...
write it down. Write down everything.
He has been awake for two days pinning those charts.
Take a look before you go. The arrows all point inward.
They have never pointed inward before.
Here, take these. He will only lose them.
You received 3 Tonic Berries.
